subject: general
question: As per the PIB report published on 17 April 2025, India's defence production has reached a new milestone by increasing from ₹40,000 crore in 2014 to over how much in the financial year 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1.27 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Press Information Bureau (PIB) report** published on **17 April 2025**, India has achieved a significant milestone in its defence production sector.
 
• India's defence production increased from ₹40,000 crore in **2014** to over **₹1.27 lakh crore in the financial year 2023-24**.
 
• This growth reflects India's focus on strengthening its **defence manufacturing capabilities** under the **‘Make in India’ initiative**.
 
• The substantial increase in defence production is attributed to the government’s efforts in promoting **indigenous manufacturing** and reducing dependence on **defence imports**.
 
• Key measures include the promotion of **private sector participation**, simplification of procurement procedures, and increased budget allocation to the defence sector.
 
• India has also focused on **exporting defence equipment**, which has helped boost production figures. Defence exports have witnessed a consistent upward trajectory in the past few years.
 
• Achieving ₹1.27 lakh crore in defence production is a major step towards realizing the government's vision of achieving **self-reliance in defence manufacturing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **‘Make in India’ initiative** was launched in **2014** with the objective of making India a global manufacturing hub.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of increasing the share of **domestic manufacturing** in critical sectors like defence, space, and electronics.
 
• The **Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020** was introduced to streamline the procurement process and encourage **domestic investments** in defence manufacturing.
 
• The government has set a target of achieving **₹1.75 lakh crore in defence production** by **2025**, including an export target of ₹35,000 crore.
